text: SGO Pro's Pinnacle prices are about 5 minutes old when read: 296 s in its first sample, and p90 of 4 min in the engine's live ranking (1.4 pts off Pinnacle). The Pinnacle feed (PinnWire/pinnapi) measures p90 under 1 s, so SGO is much staler for Pinnacle. Right now SGO is already the second source for Pinnacle and its other books, so it takes over automatically if the Pinnacle feed fails. I would not make it the first source for Pinnacle, because a 5-minute-old fair would cost real edge in pregame bets and is useless live. SGO earns its fee on breadth (62 books, props, closes/CLV), and that's what it's used for. If you want it to lead anyway, tell me and I'll flip the order.
